How do I fill units faster during a lease up?

The SocialDMNov 11, 2026
Short answer

A lease up fills faster when renters can find the community before it opens and trust what they see. That means being visible on Google, Maps, social media and AI search early, with current prices, floor plans and photos everywhere a renter looks.

Why lease ups stall

  • The property starts marketing too late, so Google, Maps and AI tools barely know it exists on opening day.
  • A new property has few or no reviews, so established communities nearby look safer.
  • Renderings and "coming soon" pages don't answer real questions about price, move in dates or the neighborhood.
  • Specials change weekly but the listings and posts don't keep up.
  • Social content shows the building but not the life around it.

What it costs you: in a lease up, every week of slow absorption means more concessions, more ad spend and a later stabilization date for ownership.

FAQ

When should lease up marketing start?

Well before opening, so search engines and AI tools know the property on day one.

What matters most early in a lease up?

Being findable and trusted before the first move in, then proving it with weekly results.

How do we show progress to ownership?

The LocalLift Weekly Pulse reports visibility, calls, direction requests and website clicks every week, not just impressions.
